name: Rita Alindogan
source:
Rita Alindogan is a drummer in a school rock band named the Counting Cards. Although you wouldn't think she'd mind being called "Lovely Rita" around campus, she would rather you left the adjective out while addressing her. Cold, reserved, and cool, she probably has better things to do than talk to you.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20120]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
